assets.title: Vieta symmetric root relations

payload.statement: For a quadratic ax^2+bx+c=0 with roots alpha and beta, coefficient ratios encode the elementary symmetric root quantities.
implications: Root sums and products can be recovered without solving the quadratic.
boundary_notes: The leading coefficient a must be nonzero.

assets.title: Sum of roots

payload.mathematical_question: How does the linear coefficient determine the sum of the roots?
inverse_uses: Recover b/a from a known root sum.
failure_cases: Do not drop the minus sign on b/a.

assets.title: Product of roots

inverse_uses: Recover c/a from a known root product.
failure_cases: The relation changes form if the equation is not first identified as a quadratic in the chosen variable.

assets.title: Coefficient sign controls root-sum sign

payload.statement: The root sum uses negative b/a, so the sign of the linear coefficient must be tracked explicitly.
implications: Prevents a frequent sign inversion when applying Vieta.

trigger_conditions: Coefficient-root translation when b is nonzero.
